name: chat-faq-bot
author: Takaro
summary: Answers common player questions in chat automatically. Match FAQ entries by keywords (any/all words) or regex, reply privately or publicly, with server and per-player cooldowns so it never spams. Placeholders {player} {prefix} {currency} plus your own. Players type faq to see topics; admins use faqlist and faqtest.
description:
Chat FAQ bot: answers the questions players ask over and over (how do I get money, discord, rules, next wipe) without staff typing it again.

- **Hook on chat messages**: the first enabled FAQ entry that matches answers.
- **Matching**: `any` (one word or phrase), `all` (every word of a keyword set, any order) or `regex`; case and punctuation are ignored; `word*` is a prefix match.
- **No spam**: per entry a server-wide cooldown and a per-player cooldown; messages shorter than the minimum length and commands (Takaro prefix plus configured prefixes like `/`) are ignored.
- **Reply mode** per entry: PM to the asker or public. If a game cannot whisper, it falls back to public (configurable).
- **Placeholders**: `{player}`, `{prefix}`, `{currency}` and your own (`{discord}`, `{rules}`, `{wipe}` by default).
- **Commands**: `faq` lists topics, `faq <topic>` shows one answer; `faqlist` (admin) shows all entries, modes, cooldowns and broken regexes; `faqtest <message>` (admin) shows which entry would answer.

Ships with a default FAQ set (money, discord, rules, wipe, commands, admin). Edit the placeholders and answers for your server.

entries.title: FAQ entries
entries.description: Checked top to bottom; the first matching entry answers.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Short name players see in the faq list, e.g. money. Also the cooldown id, so keep it unique.

match.title: Match mode
match.description: any = one trigger word/phrase appears. all = every word of one trigger appears, any order. regex = a trigger is a regular expression (case-insensitive). Add * to the end of a word for a prefix match (wip* = wipe, wiped).

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Keyword sets / phrases / regexes. One match is enough. Matching ignores case and punctuation.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Reply text. Each line is sent as its own message. Placeholders: {player} {prefix} {currency} plus your own from Placeholders.

reply.title: Reply mode
reply.description: pm = only the asker sees it. public = everyone sees it.

cooldownSeconds.title: Server cooldown (seconds)
cooldownSeconds.description: After answering, nobody gets this answer again for this long. Best for public answers.

playerCooldownSeconds.title: Player cooldown (seconds)
playerCooldownSeconds.description: After answering, the same player does not get this answer again for this long.

default.answer:
{player}, you earn {currency} by playing: kill zombies and enemies, and stay online.
Claim free {currency} with {prefix}daily and {prefix}vote. Check your balance with {prefix}balance and spend it in {prefix}shop.
Type {prefix}help to see every command, or {prefix}faq for the FAQ topics.
Staff can't always see chat. Ask for help on Discord: {discord}

placeholders.title: Placeholders
placeholders.description: Your own {name} values, used in answers. Change these for your server.

name.title: Name
name.description: Use it as {name} in an answer.

default.name: discord
default.value: discord.gg/your-invite (set this in the chat-faq-bot config)

default.name: rules
default.value: be respectful, no cheating, no exploiting, no griefing.

default.name: wipe
default.value: not scheduled yet. Watch Discord for the date.

ignorePrefixes.title: Ignore messages starting with
ignorePrefixes.description: The Takaro command prefix is always ignored. Add game command prefixes here.

messagePrefix.title: Message prefix
messagePrefix.description: Put in front of every automatic answer.

fallbackToPublic.title: Public fallback
fallbackToPublic.description: If a private message fails (game cannot whisper), answer in public chat instead.

permissions.description: Use faqlist and faqtest to inspect and test the FAQ entries.

faq.description: List FAQ topics or show one answer
faq.helpText: faq lists the topics. faq <topic or question> shows the answer privately.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.helpText: Topic name or question (default: list all topics)

faqlist.helpText: Shows every FAQ entry with match mode, reply mode, cooldowns and triggers. Needs FAQ_BOT_MANAGE.

faqtest.description: Admin: test which FAQ entry answers a message
faqtest.helpText: faqtest <message> shows which entry would answer and previews it. Needs FAQ_BOT_MANAGE.

faq-responder.description: Answers chat messages that match an FAQ entry
